plugins/auditsante/plugin_info/configura.Relance l'audit en tâche de fond et met: Runs the audit in the background and updates the device score. The weekly audit runs on Mondays.
plugins/auditsante/plugin_info/configura.Ajoute un message dans le centre de mess: Adds a message to the Jeedom message center when a check that reported nothing reports an issue.
plugins/auditsante/plugin_info/configura.Un scénario actif, avec déclencheur ou p: An active scenario, with a trigger or a schedule, that has not run for this number of days is reported.
plugins/auditsante/plugin_info/configura.Un équipement actif sans délai d'alerte: An active device with no alert delay (timeout) whose info commands have not received any value for this number of days is reported.
plugins/auditsante/plugin_info/configura.En niveau de log Debug, le plugin écrit: At Debug log level, the plugin writes the duration and result of each check to the auditsante log.
plugins/auditsante/plugin_info/configura.Passez le niveau de log sur Debug (cadre: Set the log level to Debug (Logs and monitoring panel above), run the audit again, then click Diagnostic on the plugin page and attach the downloaded file to your message on the forum. Then set the log level back to default.
plugins/auditsante/plugin_info/configura.Le plugin relève toutes les heures le no: Every hour the plugin records the name of each item, to name later the ones that get deleted. For older deletions, it reads each Jeedom backup once. Add here the folders where your old backups are copied (NAS share mounted on the box, sync folder...), then test them.
plugins/auditsante/plugin_info/configura.Dossiers repérés sur la box (partages ré: Folders found on the box (mounted network shares, folders containing backups):
Paths on the box, readable by Jeedom. Only .tar.gz files placed directly in the folder are read, once, at night or right away from the plugin page. Remember to save the configuration after adding a folder.
plugins/auditsante/plugin_info/configura.Vérifier l'accès et les sauvegardes de c: Check access to this folder and its backups
plugins/auditsante/plugin_info/configura.elle contient bien la base de Jeedom (DB: it does contain the Jeedom database (DB_backup.sql).
plugins/auditsante/plugin_info/configura.DB_backup.sql introuvable : ce n'est peu: DB_backup.sql not found: this may not be a Jeedom backup, or the archive is damaged.
plugins/auditsante/plugin_info/configura.contenu non vérifié (archive trop longue: content not checked (archive too long to scan), it will be read normally.
plugins/auditsante/plugin_info/configura.sans intérêt (postérieure(s) au premier: not needed (newer than the first record)
plugins/auditsante/plugin_info/configura.Aucune encore lue : elles le seront aprè: None read yet: they will be once the configuration is saved, at night or from the plugin page.
plugins/auditsante/plugin_info/configura.copie(s) de sauvegardes déjà présentes s: copy/copies of backups already on the box: read only once.
plugins/auditsante/plugin_info/configura.Enregistre la liste des dossiers puis li: Saves the folder list, then reads never-read backups in the background
plugins/auditsante/plugin_info/configura.La liste des dossiers va être enregistré: The folder list will be saved, then never-read backups will be read in the background (one to several minutes each). Nothing is changed in Jeedom.
plugins/auditsante/plugin_info/configura.Dossiers enregistrés. Aucune sauvegarde: Folders saved. No backup to read: all have already been read or are newer than the first name record.
plugins/auditsante/plugin_info/configura.élément(s) supprimé(s) toujours sans nom: deleted item(s) still without a name.
It keeps running if you leave the page.
plugins/auditsante/plugin_info/configura.Pour lire une ancienne sauvegarde conser: To read an old backup kept on your computer, without giving the box access to a folder. The file is read in the background, then deleted from the box. It is never restored.
plugins/auditsante/plugin_info/configura.Sauvegardes Jeedom au format .tar.gz, .t: Jeedom backups in .tar.gz, .tgz, .tar or .zip format. Stay on this page during the upload; reading then continues in the background.
plugins/auditsante/plugin_info/configura.Sauvegarde reçue, elle va être lue. Date: Backup received, it will be read. Date used:
plugins/auditsante/plugin_info/configura.Cette sauvegarde a déjà été lue par le p: This backup has already been read by the plugin.
plugins/auditsante/plugin_info/configura.Sauvegarde postérieure au premier relevé: Backup made after the first name record, it would add nothing. Date used:

plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Un audit est déjà en cours, patientez qu: An audit is already running, please wait a few seconds.
No report: run the audit first.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Aucune correction automatique pour ce co: No automatic fix for this check
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Ce contrôle ne permet pas d'exclure un é: This check does not allow excluding an item
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Audit de santé : fin de la période d'ign: Health audit: ignore period over, check(s) counted in the score again: %s
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Un peu de ménage à faire: A bit of cleanup to do
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Cet élément existe de nouveau : la référ: This item exists again: the reference is no longer broken.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Rien à retirer automatiquement : corrige: Nothing to remove automatically: fix this reference manually.

plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Quand une commande, un équipement ou un: When a command, a device or a scenario is deleted, the scenarios that used it keep a reference to a number that no longer exists (#1234#). The block involved fails silently or stops with an error.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Ouvrez chaque scénario listé : les référ: Open each listed scenario: broken references appear as a number (#1234#). Replace them with the new command or delete the block.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Équipements et commandes liés à des élém: Devices and commands linked to deleted items
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Virtuels, actions sur valeur, pré et pos: Virtual devices, actions on value, pre and post execution, linked commands (switch state...): a device or command that points to a deleted command no longer works properly.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Cliquez sur l'élément pour ouvrir l'équi: Click the item to open the device or the advanced configuration of the command, at the indicated location, and replace the missing reference. If it is no longer needed, the red “Delete… orphan” button removes the action that uses it (or clears the setting) and saves through Jeedom.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Vues, designs et résumés liés à des élém: Views, designs and summaries linked to deleted items
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Les vues, designs, designs 3D et résumés: Views, designs, 3D designs and object summaries keep deleted items: they display empty or distort the summaries (average temperature, number of lights on...).
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Éditez la vue, le design ou l'objet list: Edit the listed view, design or object and remove the missing items.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Une interaction dont la réponse ou les a: An interaction whose reply or actions use a deleted command replies badly or no longer does anything.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Corrigez ou supprimez les interactions l: Fix or delete the listed interactions.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Configuration et utilisateurs liés à des: Configuration and users linked to deleted commands
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Commandes d'alerte (timeout, batterie, d: Alert commands (timeout, battery, danger...), interaction reply command or a user's notification command: if it has been deleted, Jeedom no longer warns you.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Choisissez une nouvelle commande dans Ré: Choose a new command in Settings > System > Configuration (Logs and Interactions tabs) or in the user's profile.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Le dernier lancement de ces scénarios s': The last run of these scenarios ended with an error. They may no longer do what you expect without you noticing.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Ouvrez le log du scénario pour trouver l: Open the scenario log to find the faulty block, fix it, then run the scenario again.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Scénarios déclenchés par un équipement d: Scenarios triggered by a disabled device
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Un équipement désactivé ne remonte plus: A disabled device no longer reports any value: the scenarios it triggers no longer run. Jeedom does not report it anywhere.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Réactivez l'équipement, remplacez le déc: Re-enable the device, replace the trigger with a command of an active device, or disable the scenario if it is no longer useful. If the device is disabled on purpose (it is re-enabled by certain events), click “Exclude”.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Scénarios actifs qui ne peuvent jamais s: Active scenarios that can never run
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Ces scénarios sont actifs mais n'ont ni: These scenarios are active but have neither trigger nor schedule, are not called by any other scenario, device, interaction, view or design, and are not shown on the dashboard. So they never run, except manually or through the API.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Ajoutez le déclencheur ou la programmati: Add the missing trigger or schedule, or delete the scenario if it is no longer used. If it is run by a URL, the API or another device, click “Exclude”: it stays listed but no longer counts in the score.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Ces scénarios actifs lisent ou pilotent: These active scenarios read or control a command of a disabled device, or run a disabled scenario: these actions have no effect and the conditions read a frozen value.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Réactivez l'élément concerné ou retirez-: Re-enable the item involved or remove it from the scenario. If the item is disabled on purpose (it is re-enabled by certain events), click “Exclude”.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Ces scénarios actifs ont un déclencheur: These active scenarios have a trigger or a schedule, but have not run for a long time (or ever). The trigger condition may no longer happen: sensor replaced, mode deleted...
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Vérifiez le déclencheur de chaque scénar: Check the trigger of each listed scenario. If it is no longer used, disable or delete it. The delay is set in the plugin configuration. A scenario that by nature rarely runs (intrusion alarm, leak detection...): click “Exclude”.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Scénarios désactivés et qu'aucun autre é: Disabled scenarios that no other item enables or runs. They clutter the list and may be re-enabled by mistake.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Supprimez ceux qui ne servent plus (expo: Delete those no longer used (export them first if you want to keep them). Those enabled by another scenario are not listed. Those you keep disabled on purpose: click “Exclude”.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Scénarios sans aucun bloc : ils se lance: Scenarios without any block: they run for nothing or were created then forgotten.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Un scénario en log temps réel ou très ba: A scenario with real-time logging or very verbose can produce a file of several tens of MB. Logs of deleted scenarios also remain on the disk.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Repassez les scénarios concernés en log: Set the scenarios involved back to the default log (General tab of the scenario) and empty their log. Logs of deleted scenarios can be removed automatically.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Supprimer les logs des scénarios supprim: Delete the logs of deleted scenarios
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Les fichiers log/scenarioLog/scenarioN.l: The files log/scenarioLog/scenarioN.log whose scenario no longer exists will be deleted. Logs of existing scenarios are not touched.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Un scénario programmé toutes les minutes: A scenario scheduled every minute runs 1,440 times a day. Often, a trigger on the monitored command does the same without loading the box.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Remplacez la programmation par un déclen: Replace the schedule with a trigger when possible, or space it out (every 5 minutes...).
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Quand un plugin est supprimé ou désactiv: When a plugin is removed or disabled, its devices remain in the database: they no longer appear anywhere, but the scenarios, views and designs that use them no longer work.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Réinstallez ou réactivez le plugin si vo: Reinstall or re-enable the plugin if you still need it. Otherwise, replace these devices in your scenarios then delete them. Devices of a plugin that is no longer installed can be deleted automatically; for a disabled plugin, re-enable it temporarily and delete them from its interface.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Les équipements des plugins qui ne sont: Devices of plugins that are no longer installed will be permanently deleted, along with their commands and history. Devices of disabled plugins are not touched. Scenarios, views and designs that still used them will show a missing reference, with the device's former name.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Ces équipements n'ont pas communiqué dan: These devices have not communicated within the configured alert delay: empty battery, module out of range, device unplugged...
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Vérifiez l'alimentation et la portée de: Check the power and range of the device. If it has been removed from the house, delete its device. If it is unplugged on purpose (seasonal device: pool, heating...), click “Exclude”.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Le niveau de pile de ces équipements est: The battery level of these devices is below the alert threshold (Settings > System > Configuration > Devices, or device-specific threshold).
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Remplacez les piles avant que les module: Replace the batteries before the modules drop out.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Équipements actifs dont aucune commande: Active devices whose info commands have not received any value for a long time, and with no alert delay (timeout) configured: Jeedom never reports them. They are often dead modules or removed from the house.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Vérifiez chaque équipement. S'il fonctio: Check each device. If it works, configure an alert delay in its advanced configuration; otherwise, disable or delete it. The delay is set in the plugin configuration. A sensor that by nature rarely changes (cellar door, leak detector, emergency button...): click “Exclude”.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Équipements actifs mais masqués, dont au: Active but hidden devices, none of whose commands is historized or used elsewhere (scenario, other device, interaction, view, design, summary). They apparently serve no purpose. Commands used only in a code block of a scenario, by their name, are not detected.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Supprimez ou désactivez les équipements: Delete or disable the devices you no longer need. If it is read by an external program, the API or another Jeedom, click “Exclude”.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Un équipement désactivé ne remonte plus: A disabled device no longer reports anything but keeps its commands, history and links. Often, it matches an appliance that no longer exists.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Supprimez les équipements qui ne reviend: Delete the devices that will not come back. Those still used by scenarios are reported in « Scenarios using disabled items ». Those you keep disabled on purpose: click “Exclude”.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Équipements visibles sans objet parent: Visible devices without a parent object
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Un équipement sans objet parent n'appara: A device without a parent object does not appear on any dashboard, even if « Visible » is checked.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Rangez ces équipements dans un objet (pi: Put these devices in an object (room), or uncheck « Visible » if they do not need to be displayed.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Équipements qui n'ont aucune commande :: Devices that have no command: unfinished creation, failed inclusion or leftover of an old appliance.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Terminez leur configuration (souvent : s: Finish their configuration (often: save the device or run the plugin synchronization again) or delete them.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Commandes dont l'équipement n'existe plu: Commands whose device no longer exists. Invisible in the interface, they remain in the database with their history.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Supprimez-les : elles ne peuvent plus se: Delete them: they can no longer be used.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Supprimer les commandes sans équipement: Delete the commands without a device
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Les commandes listées et leur historique: The listed commands and their history will be permanently deleted. They no longer have a device and are no longer visible anywhere.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Valeurs historisées de commandes qui n'e: Historized values of commands that no longer exist. They take up space in the database and slow down backups, without being viewable.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Les valeurs historisées des commandes qu: The historized values of commands that no longer exist will be permanently deleted (history and historyArch tables). The history of existing commands is not touched.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Les commandes historisées sans purge, ou: Historized commands without purge, or that record a value every second, make the database grow, lengthen backups and slow down charts.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Pour les commandes les plus lourdes, rég: For the heaviest commands, set a purge (advanced configuration of the command > History) and smoothing. Remove historization from commands of disabled devices.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Commandes masquées, non historisées et u: Hidden commands, not historized and used nowhere (scenario, device, interaction, view, design, summary). They do no harm, but often point to devices that need cleaning up.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Rien d'obligatoire. Si un plugin crée be: Nothing mandatory. If a plugin creates many unused commands, check whether it lets you not create them.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Le type générique indique à l'applicatio: The generic type tells the mobile app, voice assistants and some plugins what a command does (light, plug, temperature...). Without it, the command does not appear there, or appears badly.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Renseignez les types génériques des comm: Fill in the generic types of the displayed commands, in bulk from Tools > Generic types.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Objets (pièces) sans équipement, sans ob: Objects (rooms) without devices, child objects or summary: they clutter the dashboard and selection lists.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Supprimez-les ou rangez-y les équipement: Delete them or move the relevant devices into them. An object prepared in advance or used only for grouping: click “Exclude”.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Vues sans aucun élément et designs sans: Views without any item and designs without any placed item: unfinished creation or leftover of an old organization.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Widgets créés dans Outils > Widgets qu'a: Widgets created in Tools > Widgets that no command uses.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Un plugin dont le démon est arrêté ou do: A plugin whose daemon is stopped or whose dependencies are not installed no longer communicates with its devices.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Ouvrez la configuration du plugin, relan: Open the plugin configuration, run the dependency installation again then the daemon, and check its log if it fails.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Les tâches du moteur de tâches (crons du: Tasks of the task engine (core and plugin crons) in error no longer run properly.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Consultez le log du plugin concerné, pui: Check the log of the plugin involved, then run the task again from the task engine.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Tâches planifiées et écouteurs (listener: Scheduled tasks and listeners that call a class or function that no longer exists, usually that of a removed plugin. They run for nothing and fill the logs with errors.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Supprimer les tâches et écouteurs orphel: Delete the orphan tasks and listeners
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Les tâches planifiées et écouteurs listé: The listed scheduled tasks and listeners will be deleted. They call code that no longer exists.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Un plugin désactivé reste installé : il: A disabled plugin remains installed: it takes up space, appears in the update center and its devices become ghosts.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Supprimez les plugins dont vous ne vous: Remove the plugins you no longer use, after deleting their devices. Those you keep disabled on purpose (seasonal plugin, waiting to be reused...): click “Exclude”.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Plugins activés qui n'ont aucun équipeme: Enabled plugins that have no device. Some plugins work without devices (tools, themes, gateways); the others may be useless.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Désactivez puis supprimez ceux qui ne se: Disable then remove those no longer used.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Configuration et entrées du centre de mi: Configuration and update center entries of plugins that are no longer installed. They do not affect operation but reappear if the plugin is reinstalled.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Rien d'urgent. Si vous ne réinstallerez: Nothing urgent. If you will not reinstall these plugins, these leftovers can be cleaned up by support or in the database.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Variables de scénario qu'aucun scénario: Scenario variables that no scenario (code blocks included), device, interaction, view or design reads or writes. They are often leftovers from deleted scenarios. Those used only by an external program (API) or by a plugin that keeps its own configuration also appear.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Supprimez-les depuis Outils > Variables: Delete them from Tools > Variables (« Delete » button or remove_variable action). If a variable is used without the audit seeing it (external program, name built another way), exclude it from the audit with the button to the right of its name.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Variables rattachées à un scénario ou un: Variables attached to a scenario or device that no longer exists.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Les variables listées vont être supprimé: The listed variables will be deleted. They belong to deleted scenarios or devices.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Blocs, sous-blocs et expressions de scén: Scenario blocks, sub-blocks and expressions that are no longer attached to any scenario (leftovers of interrupted deletions or copies). They take up database space for nothing.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Lancez le nettoyage de la base de Jeedom: Run the Jeedom database cleanup (Settings > System > Configuration > OS/DB tab > Cleanup) after a backup.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Les tables les plus volumineuses de la b: The largest tables of the Jeedom database. History almost always accounts for most of it.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Si la base dépasse quelques centaines de: If the database exceeds a few hundred MB, reduce the history retention period (Settings > System > Configuration > Commands) and the purge of the most verbose commands.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Un log volumineux signale souvent un plu: A large log often points to a plugin left in Debug or a recurring error. It wears out the SD card and fills the disk.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Repassez les logs concernés au niveau pa: Set the logs involved back to the default level, fix the recurring error and empty the file. The threshold is set in the plugin configuration.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Des dizaines de messages non traités noi: Dozens of unprocessed messages drown out important alerts: nobody reads them anymore.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Traitez la cause des messages répétés (p: Address the cause of repeated messages (plugin, device), then empty the message center.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Aucune correction automatique pour ce co: No automatic fix for this check
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.nom absent de l'archive des noms: name not in the name archive
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Aucun déclencheur sur un équipement désa: No trigger on a disabled device.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.%d scénario(s) concerné(s), dont %d qui: %d scenario(s) involved, of which %d can no longer be triggered.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Tous les scénarios actifs ont un moyen d: All active scenarios have a way to run.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.%d scénario(s) actif(s) sans aucun moyen: %d active scenario(s) with no way to run.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Aucun scénario actif n'utilise d'élément: No active scenario uses a disabled item.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Tous les scénarios actifs se sont lancés: All active scenarios have run within the last %d days.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.%d scénario(s) actif(s) non lancé(s) dep: %d active scenario(s) not run for more than %d days.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.%d log(s) de plus de %s, %d log(s) de sc: %d log(s) over %s, %d log(s) of deleted scenarios.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Tous les équipements appartiennent à un: All devices belong to an active plugin.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Plugin %s (%s) : %d équipement(s), dont: Plugin %s (%s): %d device(s), of which %d still used elsewhere
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.%d équipement(s) de %d plugin(s) supprim: %d device(s) from %d removed or disabled plugin(s).
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.%d pile(s) faible(s), dont %d sous le se: %d low battery(ies), of which %d below the critical threshold.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Tous les équipements actifs ont reçu une: All active devices have received a value within the last %d days.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.%d équipement(s) sans valeur reçue depui: %d device(s) with no value received for more than %d days.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Tous les équipements visibles sont rangé: All visible devices are in an object.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.%d équipement(s) visible(s) sans objet p: %d visible device(s) without a parent object.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Tous les équipements ont au moins une co: All devices have at least one command.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.%d commande(s) historisée(s) appartienne: %d historized command(s) belong to disabled devices.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.%s valeur(s) pour %d commande(s) histori: %s value(s) for %d historized command(s). Heaviest commands:
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Toutes les commandes affichées ont un ty: All displayed commands have a generic type.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.%d commande(s) affichée(s) sans type gén: %d displayed command(s) without a generic type.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Widgets personnalisés non disponibles su: Custom widgets not available on this Jeedom version.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Tous les démons en gestion automatique t: All daemons in automatic management are running and dependencies are installed.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Tous les plugins actifs ont au moins un: All active plugins have at least one device.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.%d plugin(s) qui ne gèrent pas d'équipem: %d plugin(s) that do not manage devices (tools, themes) are not counted.
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Configuration enregistrée sous un chemin: Configuration saved under a file path with no plugin name (%s)
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.Configuration du plugin %s, enregistrée: Configuration of plugin %s, saved under its file path
plugins/auditsante/core/class/auditsante.plugin installé, mais cette copie ne ser: plugin installed, but this copy is no longer used
